none: PAS FindID 995666: Roman Coin: Nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Gratian (367-383), possibly Gloria Novi Saeculi issue of 367-375 on a small reddish flan; as the type is usually Ae 3 in size, presumably a copy, Reece period 18. Obverse description: bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]O[--]. Reverse description: Emperor facing holding vertical spear with propped shield. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI].…
